The '''Shinaga no Kuni no Miyatsuko''' ({{lang|ja|師長国造}}, also read ''Shinaga kokuzō'') were the {{ill|Kuni no miyatsuko|ja|国造|lt=kuni no miyatsuko|lt_ja=国造}} who ruled the basin of the {{ill|Sakawa River|ja|酒匂川|lt=Sakawa River|lt_ja=酒匂川}} in western {{ill|Sagami Province|ja|相模国|lt=Sagami Province|lt_ja=相模国}}. The name is also written '''{{lang|ja|磯長国造}}'''.

== Overview ==
=== Ancestry ===
* The "Kokuzō Hongi" of the ''{{ill|Sendai Kuji Hongi|ja|先代旧事本紀|lt=Sendai Kuji Hongi|lt_ja=先代旧事本紀}}'' says the line began when '''{{ill|Ōwashiomi no Mikoto|ja|意富鷲意弥命|lt=Ōwashiomi no Mikoto|lt_ja=意富鷲意弥命}}''', son of {{ill|Takekoro no Mikoto|ja|建許呂命|lt=Takekoro no Mikoto|lt_ja=建許呂命}}, ancestor of the {{ill|Ubaraki no Kuni no Miyatsuko|ja|茨城国造|lt=Ubaraki no Kuni no Miyatsuko|lt_ja=茨城国造}}, was appointed ''kuni no miyatsuko'' in the reign of {{ill|Emperor Seimu|ja|成務天皇|lt=Emperor Seimu|lt_ja=成務朝}}.

== Base ==
The seat of the ''kuni no miyatsuko'' was '''Shinaga township''' in {{ill|Yurugi District|ja|余綾郡|lt=Yurugi District|lt_ja=余綾郡}}, {{ill|Sagami Province|ja|相模国|lt=Sagami Province|lt_ja=相模国}}, corresponding to the area around present-day {{ill|Ōiso, Kanagawa|ja|大磯町|lt=Ōiso|lt_ja=大磯町}} and {{ill|Ninomiya, Kanagawa|ja|二宮町|lt=Ninomiya|lt_ja=二宮町}} in {{ill|Kanagawa Prefecture|ja|神奈川県|lt=Kanagawa Prefecture|lt_ja=神奈川県}}.

== Clan deity ==
'''{{ill|Kawawa Shrine|ja|川勾神社|lt=Kawawa Shrine|lt_ja=川勾神社}}''' (かわわじんじゃ), the {{ill|Ninomiya (shrine rank)|ja|二宮|lt=ninomiya|lt_ja=二宮}} of Sagami Province.
